feeds.title: The Design Chaser
feeds.description: Founded in 2012 by interior stylist Michelle Halford, TDC is a global blog with a focus on Scandinavian interiors and design. Creating quality, engaging content, Michelle reports on topics such as interior trends, inspiring creatives and beautiful homes. She also shares her own interior styling work, and updates from the home that she and her husband built and share with their two young sons.
